summary: Rewrote Example strings so the first line is a complete runnable invocation for dogfood --level full.
reason: Publish live gate failed 13 tests: the 5 novel analytics commands had bare flag examples ('--json') that dogfood cannot turn into an invocation, and the generated learn-loop write commands (teach, teach-pattern, teach-playbook, playbook amend) used backslash-continued multi-line examples whose literal trailing backslash dogfood passed as an argument (exit 2). Generator template bug for the learn-loop family; local fix keeps first example line single-line runnable, moves continuation guidance to comment lines.
validated_outcome: Each rewritten example line executed manually with exit 0 (client-billing verified with placeholder id against live CDP transport); full live dogfood re-run 154/154 after patch.
